name: HoloCanvas
description: HoloCanvas library: browse, preview, share and narrate saved infinite-canvas walkthroughs, and build new ones from reports or markdown. The canvas runtime (overlays, share links, work-review canvases) stays in core and works without this plugin.

fs: <stateDir>/canvas-library.db (core saved-canvas store, through the canvasRuntime seam)

listing.tagline: Your library of spatial walkthroughs — browse, replay, narrate and share them.
listing.description:
**HoloCanvas** keeps every infinite-canvas walkthrough in one place.

- **Browse** — a gallery of saved canvases with tag filters, scene and card counts.
- **Preview and replay** — open any canvas inline, or show it again as an on-screen overlay.
- **Build from a report** — turn a report (or pasted markdown) into a walkthrough in one click.
- **Narrate** — bake per-scene narration audio.
- **Share** — copy a share link or download a single-file HTML export.

The canvas runtime is part of InfiniBot core: agents can still show walkthroughs, and work-review canvases and share links keep working when this plugin is off. Turning it off hides the library; your saved canvases are kept.
